extraction.scope_of_work: Modernize on-premises IT infrastructure by migrating approximately 120 virtual machines, 15 databases, and 8 web applications to a public cloud platform. Services include assessment & planning, migration execution with IaC, optimization, knowledge transfer (40 hours), and 90-day post-migration hypercare support.

requirements.text: At least 5 completed cloud migration projects of similar scale (100+ VMs) within the last 3 years
Proposed team must include at least 2 certified cloud architects
Zero unplanned downtime for Tier-1 applications during migration
All infrastructure defined as code (Terraform, Bicep, or equivalent)
Experience with Kubernetes orchestration for containerized workloads
Ability to implement FinOps practices and cost governance frameworks

extraction.contract_duration: 18 months initial, with option for two 6-month extensions
extraction.point_of_contact: Maria Chen, VP of Technology, maria.chen@northwind-traders.example.com, (206) 555-0142

analysis.executive_summary: Northwind Traders seeks a vendor to migrate approximately 120 VMs, 15 databases, and 8 web applications from on-premises infrastructure to a public cloud platform. The engagement spans 18 months with a budget of $800K–$1.2M. Key requirements include HIPAA compliance experience, certified cloud architects, zero-downtime migration for Tier-1 apps, and infrastructure-as-code. Proposals are evaluated primarily on technical approach (35%) and team qualifications (25%).
risks: HIPAA compliance requirement (R3) significantly narrows the vendor pool and may increase costs
Zero unplanned downtime requirement (R4) for Tier-1 applications demands extensive migration rehearsals
18-month timeline for 120+ VM migration is aggressive — typical projects of this scale require 12-24 months
Budget ceiling of $1.2M may be insufficient if legacy application refactoring is needed
